company.name: FlexDesk
company.shortDescription: The next generation platform for corporate real estate teams
company.description:
FlexDesk is the modern operating system for corporate real estate departments. AI-powered workflows and integrations across disparate systems enable companies to manage their corporate leases, unlock occupancy intelligence, and administer employee access to a worldwide network of coworking spaces.

Leading companies like Confluent, ezCater, Hopper, Blink Health, and others use FlexDesk to accelerate data-driven decisions and deploy efficient real estate solutions.

FlexDesk is backed by Y Combinator and headquartered in San Francisco.
